messages:
Alex Huerta: Hi — I got my MacBook Pro today and trying to finish setup. MDM enrollment keeps failing when connected to office Wi‑Fi, it hits a captive portal and never finishes. Also FileVault prompt says encryption in progress but status is stuck. Any quick fixes?
Maya Patel (IT): welcome! can you ping me the serial? we can check the DEP/MDM record. in the meantime try a hotspot (phone) — enrollment usually works off a clean network.
Alex Huerta: serial is C02X1234H7G7. Tried hotspot and enrollment started but then hung on "Applying configuration" for 10+ mins. Docker needs admin to install and I don't have admin access yet. Do we typically grant temporary admin for first week?
Maya Patel (IT): thanks — I see the device in DEP but status is "staged" not fully assigned. trying a push now. give me the "enrollment id" if it shows one in the UI.
Alex Huerta: enrollment id in the setup assistant is 7f9b2c.
mdm-bot: Enrollment push initiated for device C02X1234H7G7 (enroll id 7f9b2c).
Maya Patel (IT): pushed a reassign, should flip to "enrolled" in a minute. If it still hangs, you can do this temporary step: connect to your phone hotspot, open Safari, go to https://setup.redwood-internal/setup and complete the prompts. don't use captive portal wifi for the initial push.
Alex Huerta: ok switching networks now — will update in a sec.
it-ops-bot: Note: new-hires policy requires ticket for admin elevation. Ticket template: "Temporary admin for <device_serial> for <reason>".
Alex Huerta: Enrollment finished! mdm status now shows "Enrolled, profiles applied". FileVault status still says encrypting (25%).
mdm-bot: Device C02X1234H7G7: profiles applied. MDM profile: Standard Employee. FileVault escrow key uploaded to KMS.
Maya Patel (IT): FileVault can take a while — if it was started during heavy I/O or after restore it may take hours. I can grant a one-week admin scoping to install Docker and dev tooling. Please open a ticket with the template it-ops-bot mentioned and ping me the ticket number.
Jordan Lee: Alex — welcome! tag me when you have Docker set up and I’ll share the onboarding repo.
Alex Huerta: created ticket IT-2026 with the template and linked the device serial. pinging @Maya.
Maya Patel (IT): got it, approved. Admin elevation applied for 7 days. you should see an admin prompt after logout/login. if not, reboot once.
Alex Huerta: saw the admin user option after reboot, installing Docker Desktop now. thanks! :tada:
Maya Patel (IT): one more reminder — run the macOS security update once Docker is installed. MDM will block major OS upgrades until we validate company images, but minor security updates are fine. If you hit any blockers, DM me.
Alex Huerta: will do. appreciate the quick help everyone!
Jordan Lee: glad to have you aboard :wave:
